title: Finite-Tor domains for ordinary etale chart adjunctions
statement: Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. All schemes below are separated and finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, and choose $N=\ell^n\geq1$ annihilating both. On small ordinary etale sites use constant-ring module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and $T_T=(-)_B=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Write $D^b_{ctf}$ for bounded constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude, as in [det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer], and $R_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}R_T$ for $R=A,B$ [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]. Let $h:U\to V$ be separated of finite type, with a compactification whose middle scheme is in the standing setting. Let $F^{et}_{h,R}=Rr_{*,R}j_{!,R}$ for that compactification [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Then $F^{et}_{h,R}$ preserves $D^b_{ctf}$ for $R=A,B$. For every standing scheme $T$, comparison inverse image $\nu_T^*$ gives an equivalence $D^b_{ctf}(T_{et},R)\simeq D^b_{ctf}(T_{proet},R)$ preserving and reflecting each Tor interval [det-pe-finite-tor-comparison-noetherian]. Its canonical tensor comparisons intertwine coefficient extension, inverse image, finite Tate tensor powers and shifts on these subcategories. In particular $T_T$ preserves $D^b_{ctf}$, and for any standing map $u:T'\to T$ and $a\geq0$, $b\in\mathbf Z$, the functor $u^*(-)(a)[b]$ preserves $D^b_{ctf}$.
